reason: I already put every deadline into Google Calendar and Notion myself, and that system works for me. I might install it if the college pushes it, but a separate feed with its own alerts would just sit there next to my calendar and I'd stop opening it within a couple of weeks.
objection: It's one more app with its own notifications that doesn't talk to the calendar I already live in, so it duplicates my system instead of fitting into it.
would_change_my_mind: If it pushed deadlines and exam notices straight into my Google Calendar or Notion automatically, so I never had to open the app at all.
